create_image_transform_for_training: create a training image transform pipeline with random resized crop and normalization using image_transform
create_image_transform_for_inference: create an inference image transform pipeline with resize, center crop, and normalization using image_transform
build_resize_max_size_module: build a ResizeMaxSize module that resizes an image to fit within max_size and pads to square
configure_augmentation_cfg_dataclass: configure an AugmentationCfg dataclass with scale, ratio, color jitter, and re_prob settings
review_image_transform_resize_longest_ma: review the image_transform function to use ResizeMaxSize instead of resize and center crop
